frozen_before: any micro-cap 5-minute bar after 16:59 ET or any quote at 17:30, 18:00 or 18:30 ET was fetched; no late event list or return exists
purpose: Test the only untested part of the live AH->PM entry: entries at the 17:30, 18:00 and 18:30 ET scans. The 17:00 ET census (docs/investigations/init7-microcap-census-freeze.json) failed in all eight cells. If this also fails, the proposal to stop or replace AH->PM becomes unconditional.
origin: October 15 15:00 run: 499 events entered at the 17:00 ET ask lose -3.16% at the 04:30 bid; the 44 real entries the census misses (mostly later entries) model at +1.02%, descriptive only.
window: events dated 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (full 16:00 closes only); volume history from 2025-08-25
universe: identical to the 17:00 census: the per-day fetched set cached in log/2026-10-15/init7-microcap-census/ah/ (raw close $0.50-$10.00), minus the point-in-time top 1000 by trailing three-month SIP dollar volume
data: cached 16:00-16:59 ET 5-minute raw bars from the 17:00 census, plus new 17:00-18:29 ET 5-minute raw SIP bars for the same per-day symbol set; latest SIP quote in a window per event
checkpoints: price at time T is the close of the last 5-minute bar starting at or before T-5 minutes. Entry scans T are 17:30, 18:00 and 18:30 ET (23:30, 00:00, 00:30 CEST live scans).

event.exclusion: symbol-dates that are events in the 17:00 census (its candidates() list) are excluded; they were already scored
event.gate: price at T and price at T-30 minutes are both >= +10% above D's regular close (the two-AH-scan gate on the half-hour live scans)
event.total_ceiling: price at T <= +150% above D's regular close
event.day_change: D's regular close > -15% versus D-1's close
event.volume: shares in bars starting 16:00 through T-5 minutes >= 100,000 AND dollars >= $100,000 AND shares >= 3x the median of the same window over the symbol's prior 20 fetched sessions (sessions without bars count as zero); at least 20 prior fetched sessions required
event.first_scan: each symbol-date is an event at most once, at the earliest T in (17:30, 18:00, 18:30) where every condition holds
event.split: drop events whose raw/split-adjusted close ratio changes by >1% from D to D+1; count drops

entry: ask of the latest SIP quote at or before T with timestamp >= T-15 minutes; requires bid > 0 and ask > bid. Events without such a quote are excluded as unexecutable and counted.

exits.exit_0430: bid of the latest SIP quote in 04:00-04:30 ET on D+1; if none is valid, D+1 official open x (1 - 50 bps), counted as fallback
exits.exit_open: D+1 official raw open x (1 - 50 bps)

unit: net return per trade = exit / entry - 1; equal weight per event

subsets.build: price at T >= price at T-30 minutes
subsets.fresh: not a multi-session runner: none of D-2, D-1, D closed >= +50% above its own prior close AND D's close < 2x the close of D-3

statistics.interval: bootstrap resampling event dates (D) with replacement, 4000 draws, seed 13; two-sided interval with tail 0.025/8 (Bonferroni over 8 cells)
statistics.pass: a cell passes if mean > 0 AND interval lower bound > 0 AND both chronological halves (split by D at the median event date) have mean > 0, at base cost; also report +100 bps round-trip stress, gross mid-to-mid returns, median and win rate

descriptive_only: results by entry scan T, move buckets, close price buckets, AH dollar-volume buckets, entry spread quartiles, and recall of the 89 real entries (log/2026-10-09/init3-exec-gap/result.json) as late events, including the 44 the 17:00 census missed. None can rescue a failed pass.
decision_if_pass: do not promote: retest the passing cell unchanged on 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30. Only a pass there too leads to a narrowed live entry rule (later entry scans only), applied under the standing directive and reported for Juan's veto.
decision_if_fail: the stop-or-replace proposal to Juan becomes unconditional (daily email); no live rule changes from this census alone.
limits: consecutive half-hour checkpoints approximate the live 'two AH scans' gate, which can also count the 16:00-16:45 five-minute scans; no catalyst grading, no first-bar-spike or spike-fade skip; survivorship limited to assets Alpaca still lists; no borrow, fee or partial-fill model; quoted size ignored.
